title: Bending Spoons makes first post-IPO acquisition with $1.3B Airtable deal
summary: Bending Spoons, a European app development company, has completed its first post-IPO acquisition by purchasing Airtable, a no-code/low-code collaboration platform, for $1.3 billion. This strategic move marks Bending Spoons' expansion into the productivity software market following its public listing.
problem_solved: Addresses Bending Spoons' need to diversify beyond consumer apps and establish a stronger enterprise presence in the productivity software space.
why_valuable: This acquisition provides strategic market expansion for Bending Spoons while giving Airtable access to greater resources and international scaling opportunities following its valuation decline from peak levels.
